candidate_rule: Frozen token IDs below, teacher-forced independently from the same prefix. Score every listed token including punctuation. No appended end token, except the explicit early-stop candidate itself.
positive_direction: more hedged / AI self-reference / early stop / formal register
post_freeze: No capture, model inference or E85 outcome inspection by W-text; no candidates may change after this freeze.
prefix_rule: Exact frozen E85 input_ids through read_position inclusive; existing thinking-disabled assistant generation prefix. No additional newline, space, instruction or chat re-render. Candidate begins at the first assistant output token.
score: sum_j log P(candidate[j] | exact_prefix, candidate[:j]); c = score(positive) - score(negative), natural logs; no token-length normalization
selection_owner: W-mech2: largest signed addressed-minus-unaddressed paired dev shift, pooled over genre, dev only; freeze selected id before test analysis. Exact ties use listed contrast order. No extra contrasts or diagnostic selection arms.
stop_rule: <|im_end|> is the native Qwen chat end-of-turn special token, not an empty string or literal text to emit. Score its one token at assistant onset.
